about: The running cook as one state machine (src/core/step.ts): traces of events, each with what the app had built and what step made of it, and the readout at each (src/core/readout.ts). Generated by tools/fixtures/step.ts (npm run fixtures): do not hand-edit.

traces.note: a cold cook to Done: boil, the surface for the measured pot, the pull rung, out, cooled, Jammy, a firm white, Start again
covers: e2e sharing-final-only: nothing final at Done

traces.note: a hot start: the pull rings, the grace runs out, the cooling ends, and Start again logs the egg unanswered
covers: e2e sharing-final-only: final at Start again

traces.note: Cancel while heating: nothing logged, nothing remembered, the alarms gone
the owner's case: boiling corrected to cold after Start, back to heating, the pull later; then the tap
boiling corrected to cold after the water could have boiled, then a tap: the remembered time to boil, and the tap not remembered
cold corrected to boiling after the tap: the tap kept unread, the egg overdue, the pull now
a heavier egg pulls later, a lighter sooner, and back gives back the first pull exactly
covers: design 3: changing back gives back the plan

traces.note: a lighter egg late makes it overdue: it rings at once; changed back within the grace, the ring stops and the pull is later
covers: e2e drag-no-ring and ios drag-no-ring: one commit, one event
design 3: when a correction makes the egg overdue

traces.note: the start corrected: two minutes earlier; refused after now, after the tap, and more than two hours before Start
covers: one-screen review 3: the start has a lower bound

traces.note: Settings' water mid-cook corrects the cook
a correction at Done after an answer: the record planned on the calibration before this egg, logged in place of the first; back, and the first again
covers: design 4: never from its own outcome

traces.note: after the pull the slider only previews: a level alone corrects nothing
the grace ran out asleep, then corrected to cold: the app asks whether the egg is still in, nothing passes the question; still in: heating again
covers: running-cook review 3: the question holds the cooling
onescreen review 3: the question shows no white line

traces.note: the same question answered no: the pull stands, confirmed, the cooling runs, Done for cold water
a pull the clock assumed, Jammy at Done, then cold water: the pull confirmed, nothing asked, still Done
a slow hob: the guess lengthens, the clock counts the time heated up, and at two hours the cook is ended, nothing logged
covers: running-cook review 3: the clock counts up

traces.note: a correction the white never sets in: the longest time the pan gives, and the slot says so
covers: design 3: a correction that leaves the white unset

traces.note: Jammy at Done, then a correction and Start again at once: the corrected egg logged in place of the first, then forgotten
Done, corrected, Jammy held for the record, Start again: the egg logged with Jammy
relaunched three hours after an answered egg was corrected: too old, the corrected egg logged
on the counter: Done at the out, Jammy, then the cooling corrected to ice: still Done, nothing rung, no alarm back
Runny at Done, an egg folded, relaunched: Done shows the cook as it ran, and nothing is logged again
a lighter egg 15 s into the pull: the pull that rang held, its grace kept, nothing rung again
covers: onescreen review 3: a correction in the grace

traces.note: a page woken 25 s past the pull rings the pull; one woken past the cooling rings the pull, not Done
relaunched at each phase: the same deadlines and alarms, the pull rung once
relaunched while heating past the guess: the slow hob lengthens it, and the pending pull moves
relaunched three hours on: ended, and its finished egg logged unanswered on its pot's surface, built for it
Done, relaunched near the hour, then past it: ended at the hour, a later answer not taken
covers: one-screen review 2.1: final at the hour

traces.note: the grace ran out on the interim plan, the cooling ended, Jammy before the surface: held, and logged when it lands
covers: one-screen review 3: a surface landing never moves a pull that has rung

traces.note: the pull rings on the interim plan; its surface lands in the grace: the pull held, nothing rung again
covers: one-screen review 3: a surface landing never moves a pull that has rung

traces.note: a tap, then a stray cold -> hot -> cold: the tap still remembered at the end
